commitResults.messageTitle: Extend find command to support searching by phone number
commitResults.messageBody:
The find command now supports searching by phone number using
  the p/ prefix, in addition to name keywords using the n/
  prefix.

  Prefixes are now required for all search criteria. If both
  name and phone prefixes are provided, the command returns
  persons matching either field.
